g.text: Single unit: power wiring and cap interlock

text.tspan: (wall, inverter AC outlet or power-station AC outlet)
Pull fan OUTSIDE the panel, under its hood
Molex-to-fan lead via a grommeted hole, 0.19 A max
fuse 6.3 A slow-blow, 5x20 mm (long side wall, PSU end)
1 ft C13 jumper (cut from a C13-C14 cord)
18 AWG L / N / PE, insulated, strain-relieved
Case fan: P12 Pro PST x1 (not LN)
breaks if ANY cap is fitted
